title: Source: src/manual
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/manual

src/manual/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose the manual service version independently of runtime and Gateway versions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the manual package version constant consumed by service health/API metadata.

Boundaries

  • Package initialization does not construct the app, generate references or start a server.

Lifecycle

  • Import the version during manual app composition.

State

  • The version is immutable module metadata; there is no durable state.

Security

  • Import performs no source scan, network access or credential lookup.

Collaborators

  • manual/app.py uses version for its own service metadata.

Public surface

  • version identifies this service domain; it is not a repository freeze number.

@see src/manual/app.py

src/manual/app.py

Python · Tier A

Compose the standalone manual API, static page and read-only search/navigation endpoints.

Responsibilities

  • Load authored/generated documents, construct the search corpus and expose catalog/document/search/tag/related APIs.

Boundaries

  • The service does not execute Agent tools or own runtime scheduling. Source scanning belongs to source_catalog.py.

Lifecycle

  • create_app snapshots the corpus and search index, then registers request handlers and shared appearance/static assets.

State

  • Application state holds document maps and an in-memory search object; restart/reload regenerates the corpus.

Security

  • Document identifiers are validated before lookup. Browser HTML comes from the manual renderer; shared appearance assets are served without requiring a live Agent.

Collaborators

  • documents.py loads/renders metadata and bodies; search.py ranks documents; branding_web renders the page identity.

Public surface

  • create_app supports alternate content/root paths and disabling generated references for isolated tests.

@see src/manual/documents.py

@see src/manual/search.py

@see startmanual.sh

src/manual/assets.py

Python · Tier A

Declare the canonical shared browser assets used by every manual distribution.

Responsibilities

Keep manual HTTP routes and standalone packaging on one asset inventory.

Boundaries

Names only; no file copies or server initialization occur on import.

Lifecycle

Read by the manual app and the standalone wheel builder.

State

Immutable filenames relative to the shared Agent UI static directory.

Security

All entries are source-owned literal filenames, never request input.

Collaborators

app serves these files; build-smto-manual packages their canonical bytes.

Public surface

SHARED_UI_FILES lists the shared manual browser dependencies.

@see src/manual/app.py

src/manual/cli.py

Python · Tier A

Launch the public or local manual without starting other services.

Responsibilities

Validate listener options and select public or personalized branding.

Boundaries

Never install dependencies or start an Agent, Gateway, or website.

Lifecycle

Parse options, then give Uvicorn ownership of the listener and signals.

State

Reads AOR_MANUAL_HOST/PORT/RELOAD; CLI arguments take precedence.

Security

Bind to loopback by default; public pages never read personal Agent settings.

Collaborators

manual.app owns the corpus, HTTP routes, and shared static assets.

Public surface

main starts the manual; create_public_app supplies the public ASGI factory.

@see scripts/start-smto-manual.sh

@see src/manual/app.py

src/manual/corpus.py

Python · Tier A

Share immutable Manual snapshots between browser navigation and controller Docs tools.

Responsibilities

Own authority filters, exact bounded retrieval, pagination and lane readiness.

Boundaries

No Agent reasoning, HTTP client, arbitrary file reads or model calls live here.

Lifecycle

Load authored content once; lazily build generated content and atomically publish it.

State

Each corpus owns immutable snapshots, one background worker and bounded numeric metrics.

Security

Fetch accepts only validated corpus refs; cursors bind revision and retrieval options.

Collaborators

documents normalizes content; sections defines spans; search indexes snapshots.

Public surface

ManualCorpus supports injected documents/loaders; default_manual_corpus is local.

@see src/manual/sections.py

@see src/manual/search.py

@see src/manual/generated_cache.py

src/manual/directory_guides.py

Python · Tier A

Check that repository folders explain their immediate files and child folders.

Details

README inventory blocks are authored Markdown tables. This module checks their coverage and local targets, not whether the explanations are semantically correct. It reads only repository paths and never follows a symlink or imports inspected code.

@see src/manual/documentation_audit.py

@see docs/engineering/source-documentation-standard.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
preserved_readme 40 Return the recorded license README hash when its notice manifest protects it. The original README remains mandatory and immutable. Its maintained inventory lives in DIRECTORY.md so navigation changes cannot invalidate notice evidence. This exception applies only to the existing license-bundle manifest contract.
inventory_filename 56 Select the companion index only for a hash-protected license README.
file_explanation_gaps 61 Retain format/declaration-only descriptions as open work. The generated ledger identifies entries that could only list declarations or resource types. Those entries are navigable but do not explain responsibility. Semantic accuracy of other descriptions still requires independent review.
directory_children 81 Map each repository folder to its immediate children, including new files. Tracked vendor assets and historical evidence need navigation too. Installed dependencies, generated build output and symlinks remain outside the scan. Intermediate folders are included even when they contain only subfolders.
inventory_entries 106 Read the marked two-column inventory without mistaking prose links for entries. Return malformed or duplicate rows separately. Names are decoded from relative link targets; child-folder links end in /README.md or /DIRECTORY.md for a preserved notice README. Link labels are for readers.
folder_explanation_problem 143 Reject absent purpose prose and known generator placeholders outside inventories. Metadata, headings and navigation alone do not explain a directory. This is a structural check; substantive-looking prose still needs semantic review.
audit_directory_guides 171 Report missing guides, incomplete inventories and stale entries independently.

src/manual/directory_reference.py

Python · Tier A

Build folder inventories from existing documentation and explicit editorial summaries.

Details

Source excerpts are useful navigation, but they are not evidence of semantic review. Descriptions absent from source stay visible as inventory-only entries. The renderer does not manufacture behavior from filenames, execute modules or rewrite source.

@see src/manual/directory_guides.py

@see scripts/refresh_directory_guides.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

describe_file 61 Prefer reviewed copy, then actual source prose, then an explicitly factual inventory. The second return value records provenance. Declarations and data shapes are never represented as a behavioral review, and data values are never published.
cell 293 Keep descriptions inside a single table cell and avoid copied relative hyperlinks.
inventory_sections 299 Partition immediate children into explicit editorial responsibility groups. Reject duplicate titles, repeated children and stale assignments instead of silently dropping them. Unassigned/new children remain visible in a final section, so adding a group cannot conceal an inventory or purpose gap.
build_directory_guides 341 Render inventories while retaining authored introductions and operational guidance. Existing READMEs keep everything outside the marked block. Newly created manual indexes have unique IDs; legacy indexes remain in historical navigation. Returned provenance records do not claim that extracted prose was reviewed.

src/manual/documentation_audit.py

Python · Tier A

Measure tiered source contracts, symbol documentation and current local links.

Responsibilities

  • Return deterministic coverage counts and exact defects, without hiding legacy gaps.

Boundaries

  • Structural compliance is not a semantic correctness certification; maintainers still review whether documentation describes the implementation accurately.

Lifecycle

  • Classify files, inspect native comments/ASTs, then validate current documentation.

State

  • Read-only analysis; the CLI owns optional JSON/Markdown report writes.

Security

  • Inspect static source only; never import runtime services or emit literal defaults.

Collaborators

  • src/manual/source_contracts.py owns inventory and native comment parsing.
  • src/manual/documentation_links.py resolves current offline links.

Public surface

  • audit_repository returns counts and path-qualified failures; markdown_report renders those counts for engineers and CI artifacts.

@see scripts/source_documentation_audit.py

@see docs/engineering/source-documentation-standard.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
documentation_files 67 Walk only an authored documentation tree, pruning excluded directories first.
documentation_inventory 88 Select current Markdown from explicit classifications and all non-legacy manual pages. Newly added docs absent from the manifest are reported instead of inferred to be historical. Generated audit reports are governed by their directory owner.
javascript_symbols 130 Recognize named functions and assigned arrow controllers with adjacent docblocks. This conservative lexical inventory does not claim a full ECMAScript AST. Anonymous callbacks are outside the mandatory set; named nested controllers remain visible because browser IIFEs own much of the product's public behavior.
audit_repository 157 Audit dynamic Tier A/B denominators; prefix restricts source review, never masks defects. Known filler and repeated substantial blocks fail even when a docstring exists. Missing Python documentation remains listed by qualified symbol and source line.
audit_validation_source 319 Check maintained tests and validation tools without annotating recorded source snapshots. A file summary describes the scenarios and setup. Individual test cases are explained by those scenarios; substantial fixtures and helper APIs need their own contracts. Historical evidence retains its original source and results.
markdown_report 361 Render explicit tier denominators and defect counts without volatile timestamps.
documentation_debt 440 Normalize source findings by exact path and defect, excluding volatile line numbers. Retain multiplicity so an additional undocumented JS function with the same name or an additional filler block cannot consume an existing exception. Links and classification errors are never eligible for a source-debt baseline.
_debt_counts 462 Validate the baseline shape and count exact, independently repairable source defects.
compare_documentation_baseline 493 Reject new source debt and every link/classification failure without hiding total debt. A repaired defect cannot offset a different new defect. The caller retains report.ok as the strict full-coverage verdict and uses this separate result only when explicitly opting into the reviewed baseline.

src/manual/documentation_links.py

Python · Tier A

Validate repository and served-manual Markdown links without network requests.

Responsibilities

  • Resolve local destinations, heading fragments and manual document identifiers.

Boundaries

  • External URLs are deliberately not fetched; historical documents are not audited.

Lifecycle

  • The audit supplies current documents after classification; each link is checked against the checkout and the authored/generated manual identifier set.

State

  • All lookup state is per audit call; this module writes no files or search indexes.

Security

  • Reject repository escapes and symlinks; never open credential or environment data.

Collaborators

  • src/manual/documents.py defines the manual's ASCII heading slug convention.
  • src/manual/documentation_audit.py selects the current documentation population.

Public surface

  • check_links returns deterministic path/destination/reason records.

@see src/manual/documents.py

@see docs/engineering/documentation-authority.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

heading_ids 40 Reproduce duplicate-heading suffixes used by manual.documents.extract_headings.
link_destinations 57 Collect inline, reference-style and HTML destinations outside code examples.
check_links 66 Check file paths/fragments and /manual#doc= links; return all local defects. Absolute application routes are distinct from filesystem paths and are left to service tests. Relative Markdown paths resolve beside their source document.

src/manual/documents.py

Python · Tier A

Normalize authored/generated manual documents and render safe Markdown projections.

Responsibilities

  • Parse limited frontmatter, derive headings/tags/summaries, group navigation and render authored or generated Markdown.

Boundaries

  • Document loading does not certify source behavior; legacy/current classification and source inventory have separate owners.

Lifecycle

  • Read content into immutable ManualDocument records; merge GeneratedPage records; render bodies only for document responses.

State

  • Records retain metadata and source-relative paths. Heading duplicate counters are per document, keeping outline anchors deterministic.

Security

  • Validate document IDs before exposure; disable raw HTML in MarkdownIt and escape content in the fallback renderer.

Collaborators

  • source_catalog.py supplies generated pages; app.py consumes grouped metadata and rendered HTML; search.py consumes searchable text.

Public surface

  • load_manual_documents, catalog_payload and render_markdown define the manual service content boundary.

@see src/manual/source_catalog.py

@see src/manual/app.py

@see src/manual/search.py

src/manual/generated_cache.py

Responsibilities

Fingerprint approved source and reuse atomic versioned reference resources.

Boundaries

Packaged runtimes load build resources only; this module never queries a model.

Lifecycle

A corpus background worker calls load; an OS lock permits one cross-process builder.

State

Private user cache entries retain at most four source revisions; locks release on exit.

Security

Source inventory exclusions remain authoritative; caches contain no live settings.

Collaborators

source_catalog generates pages; smto_runtime identifies packaged resources.

Public surface

load_generated supplies normalized documents and bounded build/cache metrics.

src/manual/native_source.py

Python · Tier A

Inspect native launcher declarations without compiling or selecting a host platform.

Responsibilities

Tokenize C++ and Go comments, literals and declarations for source audits.

Boundaries

This lexical inventory cannot expand macros or resolve C++ overloads and templates.

Lifecycle

Preserve source offsets while masking non-code, then inspect balanced declarations.

State

Tokens and discovered symbols belong to one supplied source string.

Security

Never preprocess includes, import packages, execute code or read runtime state.

Collaborators

Documentation and diagnostic audits share tokens to avoid matching quoted code.

Public surface

native_tokens returns source spans; native_symbols attaches adjacent comments.

@see src/manual/documentation_audit.py

@see src/error_catalog/audit.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation

C++ function bodies are skipped after discovery so calls and local variables cannot impersonate APIs; conditionally split signatures sharing one body can therefore hide a declaration from this scan. Unsupported language forms remain a reported scanner limitation.

src/manual/reference_builder.py

Python · Tier A

Build source-reference resources in an isolated deterministic local process.

Responsibilities

Serialize the existing source generator without competing for the server GIL.

Boundaries

Build-time infrastructure only; no Agent, helper model, network or user path tool.

Lifecycle

The cache worker supplies approved source/output paths and waits for bounded exit.

State

One temporary resource is written; the parent validates and atomically publishes it.

Security

Existing source-catalog exclusions apply; no environment values are serialized.

Collaborators

generated_cache owns single-flight/timeout; source_catalog owns source authority.

Public surface

write_resource is also suitable for offline packaging resource construction.

@see src/manual/generated_cache.py

@see src/manual/source_catalog.py

src/manual/reference_resource.py

Python · Tier A

Read the same generated reference resource in product and website packages.

Responsibilities

Validate the resource envelope and deserialize generated page records.

Boundaries

No source scan, cache write, runtime service or personal settings access.

Lifecycle

Package startup and source-cache reads share this bounded reader.

Returns detached records from an immutable build artifact.

Security

Reject symlinks and oversized or malformed resources before corpus construction.

Collaborators

reference_builder writes records; documents and corpus validate their content.

Public surface

src/manual/search.py

Python · Tier A

Search the loaded manual corpus with optional in-memory FTS and deterministic fallback.

Responsibilities

  • Tokenize user queries, filter document kinds/tags and rank title/tag/summary/body matches.

Boundaries

  • Search is a projection of loaded documents; it does not crawl external sites or update source files.

Lifecycle

  • ManualSearch builds an optional SQLite FTS5 index during app composition; requests use FTS when useful and otherwise score the corpus in Python.

State

  • The SQLite database is in memory. Failure to build/query FTS falls back to the same loaded document list; no persistent index is required.

Security

  • Tokenized bounded queries and parameterized SQL avoid passing raw user query syntax to FTS. Results expose document metadata, not repository secrets.

Collaborators

  • ManualDocument defines searchable fields and API-safe metadata; manual/app.py supplies validated request limits and filters.

Public surface

  • ManualSearch.search returns at most fifty scored metadata records; fallback_score also supports related-document ranking.

@see src/manual/documents.py

@see src/manual/app.py

src/manual/sections.py

Python · Tier A

Define exact logical Manual references and nonduplicating section spans.

Responsibilities

Parse logical refs, derive Markdown spans and project safe citations.

Boundaries

References identify loaded documents, never filesystem paths or remote URLs.

Lifecycle

Corpus construction extracts spans once; fetch slices the retained document.

State

Frozen spans retain offsets, with no copies of nested section bodies.

Security

Strict identifiers and escaped citation labels prevent path and markup injection.

Collaborators

documents owns heading slugs; corpus verifies document and heading existence.

Public surface

parse_ref, split_sections and citation share the browser bookmark contract.

@see src/manual/documents.py

@see src/manual/corpus.py

src/manual/source_catalog.py

Python · Tier A

Render maintained source contracts and static service inventories for the manual.

Responsibilities

Collaborators

src/manual/source_contracts.py

Python · Tier A

Define the maintained source boundary and parse native documentation contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Share one deterministic inventory between the manual catalog and coverage audit.

Boundaries

  • Never import inspected modules, follow symlinks, or inspect installed dependencies.

Lifecycle

  • Enumerate tracked candidates, apply exclusions, then read only eligible source.

State

  • No durable state; results describe the checkout supplied by the caller.

Security

  • Resolve repository paths before reading; dependency directories are pruned in archives.

Collaborators

  • docs/engineering/source-scope.json records operational and historical script decisions.
  • src/manual/source_catalog.py consumes contracts for generated reference pages.

Public surface

  • source_inventory returns classified paths; read_contract extracts leading documentation.

@see docs/engineering/source-documentation-standard.md

@see src/manual/source_catalog.py

src/manual/static/app.css

CSS · Tier A

Style the standalone manual navigation, article and metadata panels across screen sizes.

Responsibilities

  • Own manual-local color/type tokens, reading layout, filters, search results, outlines and responsive navigation.

Boundaries

  • Styles do not select documents, fetch data or change runtime policy; browser event ownership belongs to app.js.

Lifecycle

  • The manual HTML loads these rules before its browser controller paints catalog and article content.

State

  • Visual state follows theme data attributes and navigation/filter classes; no persistent application state lives in CSS.

Security

  • Focus, contrast and overflow are presentation responsibilities; hiding a panel is not an authorization boundary.

Collaborators

src/manual/static/app.js

JavaScript · Tier A

Drive standalone manual navigation, filtered search, outlines and themed diagrams.

Responsibilities

  • Fetch catalog/documents, render kind/tag navigation and metadata, and maintain document/heading navigation in the URL hash.

Boundaries

  • The browser does not generate source references or decide which source is current; the manual API owns the corpus and rendered document bodies.

Lifecycle

  • init loads the catalog then the hash-selected document; search is debounced; hash/appearance events update the active view.

State

  • Document filters and timers are page-local. Shared appearance/session code owns permitted preferences; this module does not create its own browser persistence store.

Security

  • Metadata uses textContent; article HTML is trusted only from the manual renderer. Mermaid runs in strict security mode and restores source text on diagram failure.

Collaborators

  • manual/app.py supplies catalog/search/document APIs; index.html owns DOM anchors; app.css and shared Agent UI appearance code supply theme tokens.

Public surface

  • init, loadDocument, runSearch and renderMermaid compose the page; #doc/#heading links are the bookmark contract.

Boundaries

State

Security

  • The server performs branding substitution; Mermaid and Markdown rendering retain their own security boundaries. Vendor code remains excluded from annotation.
